security.title: Security Events
security.subtitle: Tool execution decisions and security audit log
security.memoryPolicy.title: Memory outside EYAS
security.memoryPolicy.hint: Every model, on every provider, reads and writes memory only through EYAS. Its tools are refused the places below; their content comes in only through Import data (Settings → Data portability).
security.memoryPolicy.loadError: Failed to load the memory policy: {{message}}
security.memoryPolicy.unsandboxedEscalat: Commands that asked to leave the sandbox, last 24 h
security.memoryPolicy.foreignStores: Other tools' memory on this server
security.memoryPolicy.foreignStoresAbsen: {{count}} more known locations are not on this server; they are protected as soon as they appear.
security.memoryPolicy.segmentRules: Also protected wherever they are: any folder that holds an .obsidian folder (an Obsidian vault), folders named ai-memory, and memory folders inside .claude, .grok, .codex and similar tool folders.
security.memoryPolicy.configHint: To protect another folder or file, add its absolute path to security.foreignMemoryPaths in the configuration file and restart EYAS.
security.memoryPolicy.eyasDataHint: Only EYAS reads and writes its data folder, its database and the CLI sign-ins. Models may use their conversation's workspace, Studio projects and browser downloads.
security.memoryPolicy.workspacesHint: Each conversation's model sees only its own workspace here, never another conversation's.
security.memoryPolicy.sandbox: Kernel file sandbox of the CLI providers
security.memoryPolicy.sandboxReason.noSo: socat is not installed; Claude Code needs it next to bubblewrap
security.memoryPolicy.sandboxReason.bwra: bubblewrap cannot create a sandbox here, usually because user namespaces are disabled
security.memoryPolicy.sandboxReason.plat: this operating system has no supported sandbox
security.memoryPolicy.sandboxRequiredBlo: Turns with tools on this CLI are refused while security.cliSandbox is required.
security.memoryPolicy.sandboxUnavailable: The CLI's own tools run without it; EYAS still checks every tool call it sees.
security.memoryPolicy.sandboxAutoHint: A Claude Code command that asks to run outside the sandbox always waits for a human's approval.
security.memoryPolicy.sandboxNoCli: No CLI provider is switched on.
